quranTranslation.text: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „Allah – svjetlo je nebesa i Zemlje“ – tefsir: On ih obasjava i Onaj je koji upućuje one na njima.
explanation.en: “Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth” — tafsir: He illumines them and guides those in them.

quranTranslation.text: Allah is the Protecting Guardian of those who believe. He bringeth them out of darkness into light. As for those who disbelieve, their patrons are false deities. They bring them out of light into darkness. Such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.

explanation.bs: Izvodi ih iz tmina na svjetlo – svjetlo kao uputa.
explanation.en: “He bringeth them out of darkness into light” — light as guidance.

quranTranslation.text: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,

explanation.bs: Musau i Harunu smo dali Furkan i svjetlo – Tevrat kao svjetlost.
explanation.en: We gave Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light — the Torah as radiance.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made night everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you light? Will ye not then hear?

explanation.bs: „Koji je bog, osim Allaha, da vam donese svjetlost?“ – svjetlost dana.
explanation.en: “Who is a god beside Allah who could bring you light?” — the light of day.

quranTranslation.text: And come not near unto adultery. Lo! it is an abomination and an evil way.

explanation.bs: „I ne približavajte se bludu, jer to je doista razvrat (فَاحِشَة)“ – blud kao velika ružnoća.
explanation.en: “And come not near unto adultery. Lo! it is an abomination (فَاحِشَة)” — fornication as grave ugliness.

quranTranslation.text: And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination such as no creature ever did before you?

explanation.bs: Lut: „Zar činite razvrat koji prije vas niko na svijetu nije činio?“
explanation.en: Lot: “Will ye commit abomination such as no creature ever did before you?”

quranTranslation.text: And when they do some lewdness they say: We found our fathers doing it and Allah hath enjoined it on us. Say: Allah, verily, enjoineth not lewdness. Tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?

explanation.bs: Kad učine razvrat, kažu da su tako zatekli svoje očeve – „Allah zaista ne naređuje razvrat (الْفَحْشَاء)“.
explanation.en: When they do some lewdness, they say they found their fathers doing it — “Allah, verily, enjoineth not lewdness (الْفَحْشَاء)”.

quranTranslation.text: And there may spring from you a nation who invite to goodness, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency. Such are they who are successful.

explanation.bs: „…koji pozivaju na dobro, naređuju ono što je ispravno, a odvraćaju od zla“ – مُنكَر nasuprot مَعْرُوف.
explanation.en: “…who invite to goodness, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency” — مُنكَر against مَعْرُوف.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

explanation.bs: „…i zabranjuje razvrat (الْفَحْشَاء), zlo (الْمُنكَر) i nasilje“ – obje riječi u jednom ajetu.
explanation.en: “…and forbiddeth lewdness (الْفَحْشَاء) and abomination (الْمُنكَر) and wickedness” — both words in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: Oni koji izgovore zihar „zaista izgovaraju ružnu riječ (مُنكَرًا) i laž“ – i riječ može biti مُنكَر.
explanation.en: Those who pronounce ẓihār “indeed utter an ill word (مُنكَرًا) and a lie” — a word too can be مُنكَر.

quranTranslation.text: Wheresoever ye may be, death will overtake you, even though ye were in lofty towers. Yet if a happy thing befalleth them they say: This is from Allah; and if an evil thing befalleth them they say: This is of thy doing (O Muhammad). Say (unto them): All is from Allah. What is amiss with these people that they come not nigh to understand a happening?

explanation.bs: „Pa šta je tim ljudima, jedva da ijedan govor shvataju!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “What is amiss with these people that they come not nigh to understand a happening?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein praise Him, and there is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.

explanation.bs: „… i nema ničega što Ga ne slavi hvaleći Ga, ali vi ne shvatate njihovo slavljenje“ – ono što se ne vidi, a razumom se ne dosegne.
explanation.en: “There is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise” — what is not seen, and the mind does not reach.

quranTranslation.text: That they may understand my saying.

explanation.bs: Musa: „… da shvate moj govor“ – molba da se razumije poruka; potvrdno, protuprimjer.
explanation.en: Moses: “That they may understand my saying” — a prayer that the message be grasped; affirmed, a counter-example.

quranTranslation.text: And call not those who are slain in the way of Allah "dead." Nay, they are living, only ye perceive not.

explanation.bs: „Naprotiv, živi su, samo što vi to ne primjećujete“ – o onima koji su ubijeni na Allahovu putu: živi su, ali ne za čula.
explanation.en: “Nay, they are living, only ye perceive not” — of those slain in Allah's way: alive, though not to the senses.

quranTranslation.text: Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not.

explanation.bs: „Zaista, oni su ti koji nered čine, ali to ne osjećaju“ – ne primjećuju šta čine.
explanation.en: “Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not” — they do not notice what they do.

quranTranslation.text: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.

explanation.bs: „… pa da im dođe iznenada, a da oni ne osjete“ – kazna koju ne primijete dok ne stigne.
explanation.en: “So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not” — a punishment unnoticed until it arrives.
